resources.string: Fight through the Hollow, shape your build, and push farther with every run.

Three areas lead from the Outer Ruins to the Warden\'s Keep.
A slow 225% hit that stuns the target and makes it take more damage.
A wide ATK hit that also damages enemies beside the target.
A patient finishing blow that becomes devastating below 30% health.
Hits every enemy and applies Burning.
Deals heavy damage to one target and applies two Burning stacks.
Damages every enemy and applies Chill.
Deals bonus damage to Chilled targets and removes Chill.
Sweeps every enemy and gains execute power against weakened targets.
Deals damage to one target, then restores HP.
Hits three times with a short recovery.
Deals Fire damage and applies one Burning stack.
Marks the target and adds two Burning stacks, up to three.
Restores HP and briefly increases ARMOR.
Deals Ice damage and applies Chill.
Hits every enemy and deals bonus damage to Chilled targets.
Targets the weakest enemy and gains 100% power below 30% health.

Combo charges and order update automatically.

Hero defeated. The encounter can be retried.
BASTION · Break the Bulwark before the Warden outlasts you.
REFLECTION · The Shade Mimic resists attacks matching your latest element.
FRACTURE · Stop the combo disruption or burst down the Warden.
Phase I — Bastion. A Hollow Bulwark protects the Warden.
Phase II — Reflection. A Shade Mimic answers your latest element.
Phase III — Fracture. Soul Leech and Magic Seer disrupt your combo.
Raises Armor with an Ice barrier.
Bastion held. Break the Hollow Bulwark or bring ARMOR PEN.
Elemental reflection held. Change the final element before striking the Shade Mimic.
The combo broke. Prioritize Soul Leech and Magic Seer, or burst down the Warden.
Resistance held against the final element. Change the element before pushing again.

Enemies learn from damage and healing after each victory. Repeated elements gain resistance and better rewards, while unused elements lose resistance. After Tier 4, resistance and rewards can grow up to Tier 1,000. Changes affect new enemies.

Storage is available again; adventure can resume.
Choose a preset, then customize your Auto Battle rules. Applying a preset replaces your current rules.
Auto Battle rules are temporarily unavailable.
Rules run top to bottom. Queued skills take priority; Basic Attack fills the gaps.
The first ready rule wins. Put healing and setup before fast attacks. Queued skills take priority; Basic Attack fills gaps while skills recharge.
Rules run from top to bottom. An invalid action is skipped and the next rule is checked.
No Auto Battle rules yet. Basic Attack is the fallback.
This rule references a locked or unequipped skill and will be skipped.

Combo must contain at least one element.

Not discovered. Triggering it will add it to the Codex.

Spend Gold to improve your stats. Milestone levels 10 and 20 give extra power.
Use each element to deal damage or restore missing HP and earn Mastery. Mastery unlocks skills; it is not a direct damage bonus and resets when you Chronicle.

These are Mastery requirements. See Skills for Level and other element requirements.
Gain up to 5 levels in this stat track now. Every future Chronicle starts this track at Level 5, saving the first 200 Gold. Buy once; choose the stats that support your build.
Every future Chronicle begins with 100 Gold for your next build. This purchase does not reset your current run.
Adds one Auto Battle rule slot. Build longer plans for survival, targeting, and combo timing. This upgrade remains after Chronicle.
Future Chronicles begin with Stages 1–3 cleared and ready to farm. Push starts at Stage 4 so you can skip the opening battles.
Echo Shards: starts at Level %1$d after Chronicle
Enemies learn from your attacks. Repeated elements face more resistance and earn better rewards. Change your skills to let unused resistance fade.
Only SPD increasing? Check which skills Auto Battle actually uses. Equipping a Fire skill does not add Fire resistance until it deals damage. Healing must restore missing HP to count.
